plainName: One ceiling over the investments, the pension-fund annuity and your own pension contribution
summary: The investments deduction, the pension-fund annuity and your own pension contribution do not each have a ceiling of their own to add up: together they share one ceiling, and whatever is beyond it is not deducted. The further deduction for your own pension contribution, and your employer's contribution, sit outside this ceiling.

routes.name: The three together, within one ceiling
routes.description: Everything counted towards the investments ceiling is added up and held within it.
